gold: SELECT row_count FROM session ORDER BY session_id

q: 차량 속도가 60 km/h를 넘은 샘플은 전부 몇 개야?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample WHERE vehicle_speed_kmh > 60

q: 세션별 최고 속도와 평균 팩 전압을 알려 줘.
gold: SELECT MAX(vehicle_speed_kmh), AVG(bms_voltage) FROM sample GROUP BY session_id

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 샘플이 1,000개 이상인 세션과 그 개수는?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample_flags WHERE inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT bad_inv AND NOT bad_bms GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
gold_note: 2026-11-20: 분석 규칙 4(부하 구간 질문은 bad_inv·bad_bms 행을 뺀다)와 맞춤. 전에는 차이가 0.1%라 채점 허용 오차(0.2%) 안에 숨어 있었음 (AI_LOG #21)

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 구간에서, 보정 계수를 적용한 팩 전류의 세션별 평균은?
gold: SELECT AVG(s.bms_current * c.factor) FROM sample s JOIN scale_correction c ON c.column_name = 'bms_current' WHERE s.inv_dc_current > 25 GROUP BY s.session_id

q: 전체 평균 속도보다 빠른 샘플이 세션별로 몇 개야?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample WHERE vehicle_speed_kmh > (SELECT AVG(vehicle_speed_kmh) FROM sample) GROUP BY session_id

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 구간에서 팩 전류를 인버터 전류로 나눈 비율의 세션별 평균은?
gold: SELECT AVG(bms_current / inv_dc_current) FROM sample WHERE inv_dc_current > 25 GROUP BY session_id

q: MCU 시각으로 본 샘플 간격(바로 앞 샘플과의 차이) 중 가장 자주 나온 값 5개와 각각의 횟수는?
gold: WITH g AS (SELECT stm_ms - LAG(stm_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_no) AS d FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_ms) SELECT d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM g WHERE d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 구간에서 팩 전류/인버터 전류 비율의 세션별 중앙값은?
gold: WITH r AS (SELECT session_id, bms_current / inv_dc_current AS v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY bms_current / inv_dc_current) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS n FROM sample WHERE inv_dc_current > 25) SELECT AVG(v) FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2) GROUP BY session_id

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 상태가 끊기지 않고 이어진 구간은 세션별로 몇 개이고, 가장 긴 구간은 몇 샘플이야?
gold: WITH l AS (SELECT session_id, row_no - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_no) AS grp FROM sample_flags WHERE inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT bad_inv AND NOT bad_bms), seg AS (SELECT session_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS len FROM l GROUP BY session_id, grp) SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(len) FROM seg GROUP BY session_id

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 구간에서 팩 전류를 인버터 전류에 대해 직선으로 맞추면 세션별 기울기는?
gold: WITH a AS (SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(inv_dc_current) sx, SUM(bms_current) sy, SUM(inv_dc_current*inv_dc_current) sxx, SUM(inv_dc_current*bms_current) sxy FROM sample_flags WHERE inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT bad_inv AND NOT bad_bms GROUP BY session_id) SELECT (n*sxy - sx*sy) / (n*sxx - sx*sx) FROM a

SELECT 누락률_pct FROM (WITH clean AS (
    SELECT session_id, row_no, stm_ms FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_ms
),
gap AS (
    SELECT session_id,
           stm_ms - LAG(stm_ms) OVER w        AS d,
           row_no - LAG(row_no) OVER w - 1    AS skipped
    FROM clean
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_no)
),
miss AS (
    SELECT session_id, d,
           CASE WHEN d > 15 AND d <= 1000 THEN MAX(ROUND(d / 10.0) - 1 - skipped, 0) ELSE 0 END AS m
    FROM gap
)
SELECT se.label AS 세션,
       se.row_count AS 받은_샘플,
       SUM(m) AS 빠진_샘플,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m) / (se.row_count + SUM(m)), 1) AS 누락률_pct,
       SUM(d > 1000) AS 멈춘_구간,
       SUM(d < 0)    AS MCU_재시작
FROM miss JOIN session se USING (session_id)
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY session_id)

SELECT 깨진_비율_pct FROM (SELECT se.label AS 세션, se.row_count AS 전체_행,
       SUM(bad_ms) AS 시각_깨짐, SUM(bad_inv) AS 인버터전류_튐, SUM(bad_bms) AS 팩전류_튐, SUM(bad_speed) AS 속도_튐,
       SUM(bad_value) AS 값_튐, SUM(n_bad_cols >= 3) AS 행_손상,
       SUM(bad_ms OR bad_inv OR bad_bms OR bad_speed OR bad_value) AS 깨진_행,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(bad_ms OR bad_inv OR bad_bms OR bad_speed OR bad_value) / se.row_count, 3) AS 깨진_비율_pct
FROM sample_flags JOIN session se USING (session_id)
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY session_id)
gold_note: 2026-11-20: sql/05 를 복사해 둔 정답이 옛 규칙(4개 표시) 그대로였음 → 지금 sql/05 (값 검사 포함)로 (AI_LOG #22)

q: 보정 계수를 적용한 뒤에도 인버터 전류가 팩 전류보다 5% 넘게 큰 샘플은 부하 구간에서 세션별로 몇 %야?
gold:
SELECT 위반_보정후_pct FROM (WITH k AS (SELECT factor FROM scale_correction WHERE column_name = 'bms_current'),
load AS (
    SELECT f.session_id, f.inv_dc_current AS inv, f.bms_current AS bms, f.bms_current * k.factor AS bms_corr
    FROM sample_flags f CROSS JOIN k
    WHERE f.inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT f.bad_inv AND NOT f.bad_bms
)
SELECT se.label AS 세션,
       COUNT(*) AS 부하_행수,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(inv > 1.05 * bms)      / COUNT(*), 1) AS 위반_보정전_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(inv > 1.05 * bms_corr) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 위반_보정후_pct
FROM load JOIN session se USING (session_id)
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY session_id)
